rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are short transmittal letters concerning two bills implementing recommendations from an earlier presidential message; both summarize the first and second bills separately, explain the shortages or needs addressed, and close by referring the reader to enclosed agency letters for greater detail. The close correspondence in language, sequence, and function is substantially stronger than a generic legislative-transmittal convention. C13 and C10 share parts of the same Kennedy-era transmittal formula, but C16 uniquely matches the child’s two-bill structure and paired proposal descriptions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith drafts of two bills designed to carry out recommendations set forth in my message of February 20th to the Congress
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith two drafts of legislation to carry out recommendations I made in my message to the Congress on February ninth.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively close opening language identifies two legislative drafts as implementations of recommendations in an earlier message to Congress.

shared_material.child_excerpt: One bill provides for the construction of academic facilities and for undergraduate scholarships. The other bill provides for housing facilities for the students.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The first bill would, when enacted, increase opportunities for training physicians, dentists and professional public health personnel. ... The other bill which I am transmitting will help expand and improve community facilities and services
shared_material.explanation: Both letters organize the substantive summary as a first proposal followed by a second proposal, adapting the same two-bill explanatory sequence to a different policy field.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Enclosed are letters from the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare and from the Housing and Home Finance Agency Administrator describing the two proposals in more detail.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The enclosed letters from the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare describe the two proposals in more detail.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces the enclosure sentence and its function, adding the second responsible agency appropriate to the college-housing proposal.
